title: Issues and returns
intro: Issue stock from storage to kitchens or cost centers, and return unused stock back to inventory.

sections.title: Issues
steps: Create an issue document with destination (kitchen or department) and lines.
Saving removes quantity from the source location.
sections.caption: Issues list.

sections.title: Issue returns
sections.intro: Return unused issued items so stock is available again.
steps: Select the original issue or enter return lines.
Saving adds quantity back to the inventory location.
sections.caption: Issue returns tab.
